customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer profile (seed uuid or content hash).

name.meaning: Full name on the customer profile, as the customer registered it.

email.meaning: Email address on the customer profile; the sign-in identity and an identity-verification credential.

phone_number.meaning: Mobile number on the customer profile; an identity-verification credential.

date_of_birth.meaning: Date of birth on the customer profile; an identity-verification credential and the basis of the loyalty age gate and birthday month.

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the default billing address; an identity-verification credential.

billing_state.meaning: State of the default billing address; the state whose gift-card law governs cash-out of the customer's gift cards.

account_opened_date.meaning: Date the customer profile was created.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the verification record (content hash of the customer id).

customer_id.meaning: Customer whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers).

verified.meaning: Whether identity verification passed; once true it never returns to false.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the handoff record (content hash of customer id and reason).

customer_id.meaning: Customer handed to a human representative (foreign key -> customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

membership_id.meaning: Primary id of the Marlowe Rewards membership.

variant_name.meaning: Tier currently held, as the official tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the membership (see the loyalty lifecycle).

tier_start_date.meaning: Date the tier currently held took effect.

tier_valid_through.meaning: Last day the tier currently held is valid before the annual review re-evaluates it (always a 31 December).

points_balance.meaning: Current points balance, pending plus available; identically the sum of points over the membership's loyalty_ledger rows.

suspension_reason.meaning: Why the membership is suspended; none while it is not suspended.

closed_date.meaning: Date the membership closed; empty while open.

loyalty_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the points ledger row.

membership_id.meaning: Membership the points belong to (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships).

available_date.meaning: Date the points of this row count as available; equal to posting_date except for pending earnings.

points.meaning: Signed points delta: positive for earnings and bonuses, negative for reversals, conversions and forfeitures.

order_id.meaning: Order the row relates to (earnings and reversals; foreign key -> orders); empty otherwise.

return_id.meaning: Return whose refund caused a reversal (foreign key -> return_cases); empty otherwise.

earn_source.meaning: How an earning row arose; not_applicable on non-earning rows.

qualifying_spend_usd.meaning: Qualifying spend on which an earning row was computed; 0.00 on other rows.

reversed_spend_usd.meaning: Refunded merchandise amount on which a reversal was computed; 0.00 on other rows.

tier_at_posting.meaning: Tier held on the posting date (the tier whose parameters were applied).

tier_multiplier_applied.meaning: Points multiplier applied on an earning row, or copied from the original earning row on a reversal.

bonus_type.meaning: Kind of bonus on a bonus row; not_applicable on other rows.

bonus_reference.format: membership id (welcome) | YYYY (birthday) | REV-####### (product_review) | customer id (referral) | claim id (service_goodwill); empty on non-bonus rows
bonus_reference.meaning: The object a bonus row is for; together with bonus_type it identifies the bonus.

reward_value_usd.meaning: Value of the Marlowe Rewards Note issued by a conversion row; 0.00 on other rows.

forfeit_reason.meaning: Why a forfeiture row posted; not_applicable on other rows.

last_activity_date.meaning: Posting date of the latest earning row, recorded on inactivity forfeitures; empty otherwise.

loyalty_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the membership request.

membership_id.meaning: Membership the request concerns (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships).

request_status.meaning: Whether the customer has personally confirmed the request.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

order_id.meaning: Primary id of the order; the M&F order number the customer sees.

customer_id.meaning: Customer who placed the order (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Delivery service of the order, as the official service name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the order (see the orders lifecycle).

placed_date.meaning: Calendar date the order was placed, Eastern Time.

ship_to_address_line.meaning: Street line of the shipping address as the customer entered it.

ship_to_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the shipping address.

merchandise_subtotal_usd.meaning: Sum of line prices before promotion discounts at placement.

discount_total_usd.meaning: Sum of promotion discounts allocated at placement (positive).

order_total_usd.meaning: Total authorized at placement: merchandise after discounts plus shipping fee, surcharge and tax.

promo_code.meaning: Promotion code on the order exactly as registered (e.g. FALLEDIT20); empty when none.

is_gift.meaning: Whether the customer marked the order as a gift at checkout; a gift order's recipient may make a Gift Return.

promised_delivery_date.meaning: Last date of the delivery promise; recomputed at dispatch.

shipped_date.meaning: Date the first parcel was dispatched; empty before dispatch.

carrier_tracking_number.meaning: Carrier tracking number of the first parcel; empty before dispatch.

delivered_date.meaning: Date the carrier recorded the last parcel delivered; empty until then.

cancelled_date.meaning: Date the order was cancelled; empty otherwise.

cancel_reason.meaning: Why the whole order was cancelled; none when not cancelled.

closed_date.meaning: Date the order closed; empty while open.

close_reason.meaning: How the order closed; none while open.

order_line_id.meaning: Primary id of the line row.

order_id.meaning: Order the row belongs to (foreign key -> orders).

customer_id.meaning: Customer who placed the order (foreign key -> customers).

booked_line_id.meaning: For cancellation, price-adjustment and late-promotion rows, the order_line_id of the booking row they act on; empty on booking rows.

line_number.meaning: Line position on the order (1, 2, ...); repeated on rows that act on that line.

sku.meaning: SKU of the item on the line; empty on non-booking rows.

style_name.meaning: Product name as sold; empty on non-booking rows.

size.meaning: Size as sold (e.g. M, 32x30, US 9.5); empty on non-booking rows.

color.meaning: Colour as sold; empty on non-booking rows.

product_class.meaning: Merchandise class of the booked item; not_applicable on non-booking rows.

quantity.meaning: Units on the booked line; 0 on non-booking rows.

unit_price_usd.meaning: Selling price per unit before code discounts on the booked line.

price_type.meaning: Price type at which the line sold; not_applicable on non-booking rows.

final_sale.meaning: Whether the booked line was sold as final sale.

line_discount_usd.meaning: Promotion discount allocated to the line (positive) on booking and late-promotion rows; 0.00 otherwise.

amount_usd.meaning: Signed effect on the order's merchandise value: positive net amount on booking rows, negative on cancellation, price-adjustment and late-promotion rows.

promo_code.meaning: Code whose discount is on the row, exactly as registered; empty when none.

cancel_reason.meaning: Why a line was cancelled; not_applicable on other rows.

reference_price_usd.meaning: Lower regular site price per unit used for a price adjustment; 0.00 on other rows.

payment_id.meaning: Primary id of the payment row.

order_id.meaning: Order the payment belongs to (foreign key -> orders).

customer_id.meaning: Customer who placed the order (foreign key -> customers).

instrument_id.meaning: Stored-value instrument drawn on or refunded (foreign key -> credit_instruments); empty for card_or_wallet.

amount_usd.meaning: Signed amount: positive when captured, negative when refunded.

refund_component.meaning: Why an order-level refund was made (delivery_claim = a refund decided under the claims charter); not_applicable on captures.

booked_line_id.meaning: Booking row a line-level refund is for (foreign key -> order_lines); empty otherwise.

instrument_id.meaning: Primary id of the stored-value instrument.

variant_name.meaning: Instrument type, as the official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the instrument (see the credit lifecycle).

valid_from_date.meaning: First date the instrument can be spent.

expiry_date.meaning: Last date an expiring instrument can be spent; empty for instruments that never expire.

balance_usd.meaning: Current spendable balance; identically the sum of amount_usd over the instrument's credit_transactions rows.

card_number_last4.meaning: Last four digits of a bearer card's number; empty for account-bound instruments.

source_reference.meaning: Object the instrument was issued for: an order_line_id (purchase), loyalty_entry_id (Rewards Note conversion), return_id (refund or note reissue), claim_id (goodwill) or the instrument_id it replaces or consolidates.

registered_date.meaning: Date a bearer card was registered to the current holder's profile; empty if never registered.

lock_reason.meaning: Why the instrument is locked; none when not locked.

locked_date.meaning: Date of the most recent lock; empty if never locked.

closed_date.meaning: Date the instrument closed; empty while open.

close_reason.meaning: How the instrument closed; none while open.

credit_txn_id.meaning: Primary id of the instrument transaction.

instrument_id.meaning: Instrument the transaction is booked on (foreign key -> credit_instruments).

customer_id.meaning: Holder of record at the time of the transaction (foreign key -> customers).

amount_usd.meaning: Signed balance delta: positive for loads and refunds, negative for spending, clawbacks, transfers out, cash-outs and forfeitures.

load_type.meaning: Kind of load; not_applicable on other rows.

source_reference.meaning: On load rows: the object the value came from (see credit_instruments.source_reference, or the instrument the value moved from); empty otherwise.

order_id.meaning: Order spent on or refunded, or whose gift-card purchase refund caused a clawback (foreign key -> orders); empty otherwise.

return_id.meaning: Return whose refund or failed inspection the row books (foreign key -> return_cases); empty otherwise.

clawback_reason.meaning: Why value was clawed back; not_applicable on other rows.

transfer_reason.meaning: Why value was moved out; not_applicable on other rows.

counterpart_instrument_id.meaning: Instrument receiving value moved out (foreign key -> credit_instruments); empty otherwise.

cash_out_state.meaning: Billing state whose gift-card law a cash-out applied; empty on other rows.

credit_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the holder request.

instrument_id.meaning: Instrument the request concerns (foreign key -> credit_instruments); a consolidation records one request per instrument.

request_status.meaning: Whether the holder has personally confirmed the request.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

return_id.meaning: Primary id of the return authorization; the RMA number the customer sees.

customer_id.meaning: Customer returning: the purchaser, or the gift recipient on a Gift Return (foreign key -> customers).

order_id.meaning: Order the returned units came from (foreign key -> orders).

variant_name.meaning: Return type, as the official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the return (see the returns lifecycle).

return_method.meaning: How the parcel is sent back; selects the method fee in the method fee register.

return_by_date.meaning: Last date a first carrier scan counts as on time.

deadline_extensions_used.meaning: Number of deadline extensions already granted on this return.

defect_photo_reference.meaning: Upload reference of the customer's defect photos (e.g. IMG-20261002-4471), copied exactly; empty when none.

exchange_sku.meaning: Replacement SKU on an exchange; empty otherwise.

tracking_number.meaning: Carrier tracking number of the return parcel; empty before the first scan.

first_scan_date.meaning: Date of the first carrier scan; the proof the parcel was sent on time. Empty before the scan.

received_date.meaning: Date the returns centre received the parcel; empty before.

inspected_date.meaning: Date inspection results were posted (or the parcel was deemed received); empty before.

settled_date.meaning: Date the return was settled; empty before.

closed_date.meaning: Date the return was cancelled or expired; empty otherwise.

return_line_id.meaning: Primary id of the return line row.

return_id.meaning: Return the row belongs to (foreign key -> return_cases).

booked_line_id.meaning: The order_lines booking row whose units are returned (foreign key -> order_lines).

line_number.meaning: Line position of the booking row on the order.

quantity.meaning: Units authorized on the line, or units found in the grade on an inspection row.

return_reason.meaning: Reason the customer gave, on authorization rows; not_applicable on inspection rows.

exchange_sku.meaning: Replacement SKU for the line on an exchange; empty otherwise.

condition_grade.meaning: Inspection grade: A unworn with tags, B unworn tags detached, C worn/washed/altered/damaged, missing not in the parcel; not_applicable on authorization rows.

box_condition.meaning: Footwear box condition at inspection; not_applicable for non-footwear and authorization rows.

inspection_outcome.meaning: Inspection outcome of the units in the row; not_applicable on authorization rows.

settlement_id.meaning: Primary id of the settlement row.

return_id.meaning: Return the row belongs to (foreign key -> return_cases).

order_id.meaning: Original order of the return (foreign key -> orders).

booked_line_id.meaning: Booking row a line-level credit or fee is for (foreign key -> order_lines); empty for return-level rows.

merchandise_amount_usd.meaning: Merchandise part of a credit row: net unit price paid times accepted units; 0.00 on other rows.

tax_amount_usd.meaning: Sales tax part of a credit row; 0.00 on other rows.

shipping_amount_usd.meaning: Original shipping fee and surcharge share on a credit row (Quality Issue Return only); 0.00 otherwise.

amount_usd.meaning: Signed delta on the row's account: credits, recoveries and hold placements positive; fees, refunds paid and hold releases or charges negative.

fee_type.meaning: Kind of fee withheld; not_applicable on other rows.

refund_stage.meaning: When a refund was paid; not_applicable on other rows.

tender_type.meaning: Tender a refund was paid to; return_store_credit_new means a newly issued Return Store Credit; not_applicable on other rows.

instrument_id.meaning: Existing stored-value instrument refunded or clawed back (foreign key -> credit_instruments); empty otherwise.

recovered_from.meaning: Where an instant-credit recovery was taken from; not_applicable on other rows.

exchange_order_id.meaning: No-charge order carrying an exchange replacement (foreign key -> orders); empty otherwise.

exchange_sku.meaning: Replacement SKU shipped; empty on other rows.

hold_action.meaning: Instant Exchange hold action; not_applicable on other rows.

reservation_id.meaning: Primary id of the reservation; the reservation number the customer sees.

variant_name.meaning: Reservation type, as the official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the reservation (see the preorders lifecycle).

reserved_date.meaning: Date the reservation was made, Eastern Time.

reserved_time_et.meaning: Time the reservation was made; decides launch early access and allocation order.

style_code.meaning: Style of the reserved SKU; the key of the launch per-style limit.

unit_price_usd.meaning: Current reserved unit price (lowered by price protection, never raised).

deposit_required_usd.meaning: Deposit due at reservation; 0.00 for types without a deposit.

original_ship_by_date.meaning: Ship-by date promised at reservation; the anchor of deemed-consent and cumulative-delay limits.

current_ship_by_date.meaning: Ship-by date currently in force after any accepted delay.

delay_notice_count.meaning: Number of delay notices sent for the reservation.

consent_deadline_date.meaning: Last day the customer can expressly consent to a pending delay; empty unless awaiting_consent.

personalization_text.meaning: Personalisation exactly as the customer gave or confirmed it (Made-to-Order only); empty otherwise.

specs_confirmed_date.meaning: Date the customer personally confirmed size and personalisation; empty until then.

size_changes_used.meaning: Number of size changes already made.

production_start_date.meaning: Date production started (Made-to-Order only); empty otherwise.

allocated_date.meaning: Date a unit was set aside; empty before allocation.

fulfilled_date.meaning: Date the item shipped; empty before.

fulfilment_order_id.meaning: Order that carried the item at shipment (foreign key -> orders); empty before.

cancelled_date.meaning: Date the reservation was cancelled; empty otherwise.

cancel_reason.meaning: Why the reservation was cancelled; none when not cancelled.

reservation_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the reservation event row.

reservation_id.meaning: Reservation the row belongs to (foreign key -> reservations).

amount_usd.meaning: Signed deposit delta: positive when captured, negative when refunded, forfeited or applied; 0.00 on notice and authorization rows.

tender_type.meaning: Tender of a deposit capture; not_applicable on other rows.

refund_reason.meaning: Cancel reason behind a deposit refund or forfeiture; not_applicable on other rows.

fulfilment_order_id.meaning: Order the deposit was applied to (foreign key -> orders); empty otherwise.

notice_number.format: positive integer, or 0 on non-notice rows
notice_number.meaning: Sequence number of a delay notice for the reservation.

revised_ship_by_date.meaning: Revised ship-by date announced by a delay notice; empty on other rows.

consent_mode.meaning: Whether a delay notice treats silence as consent; not_applicable on other rows.

auth_amount_usd.meaning: Amount of a renewed authorization; 0.00 on other rows.

auth_outcome.meaning: Result of an authorization renewal; not_applicable on other rows.

reservation_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the reservation request.

reservation_id.meaning: Reservation the request concerns (foreign key -> reservations).

request_type.meaning: What the customer asked for: cancelling a made-to-order item in production, forfeiting its deposit.

request_status.meaning: Whether the customer has personally confirmed the request.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

claim_id.meaning: Primary id of the delivery claim; the claim number the customer sees.

customer_id.meaning: Customer who placed the order and opened the claim (foreign key -> customers).

order_id.meaning: Order the claim concerns (foreign key -> orders).

variant_name.meaning: Claim type, as the official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the claim (see the claims lifecycle).

claimed_value_usd.meaning: Value claimed: net merchandise paid plus tax of the whole order (parcel scope) or of the claimed lines (line scope).

trace_opened_date.meaning: Date a carrier trace was opened; empty if none.

trace_reference.meaning: Carrier's trace reference exactly as issued; empty if none.

trace_result.meaning: Outcome of the carrier trace; none until concluded or when no trace ran.

decision_date.meaning: Date of the latest approval or denial; empty before a decision.

resolution_type.meaning: How an approved claim is made whole; none until approved.

denial_reason.meaning: Why the claim was denied; none unless denied.

appeal_count.meaning: Number of appeals made on the claim.

resolved_date.meaning: Date the compensation was booked and the claim resolved; empty before.

withdrawn_date.meaning: Date the customer withdrew the claim; empty otherwise.

claim_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim event row.

claim_id.meaning: Claim the row belongs to (foreign key -> delivery_claims).

customer_id.meaning: Customer of the claim (foreign key -> customers).

evidence_type.meaning: Kind of evidence on an evidence row; not_applicable on other rows.

evidence_reference.meaning: Reference of the evidence exactly as given (upload id, declaration id, police report number, trace reference); empty on other rows.

booked_line_id.meaning: Order line the row concerns (foreign key -> order_lines); empty for parcel-level rows.

compensation_type.meaning: Kind of compensation on a compensation row; not_applicable on other rows.

quantity.meaning: Units reshipped, refunded or charged; 0 on parcel-level and evidence rows.

amount_usd.meaning: Signed compensation delta: positive when compensation is given, negative when value is recovered; 0.00 on evidence rows.

replacement_order_id.meaning: No-charge order carrying a reshipment (foreign key -> orders); empty otherwise.

recovery_reason.meaning: Why value was recovered; not_applicable on other rows.

pass_id.meaning: Primary id of the Unlimited membership.

variant_name.meaning: Plan currently held, as the official plan name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the membership (see the pass lifecycle).

trial_end_date.meaning: Last day of the trial; equal to the enrollment date when no trial applied.

current_period_start.meaning: First day of the current trial or paid period.

current_period_end.meaning: Last day of the current trial or paid period.

auto_renew.meaning: Whether the membership renews at the end of the current period.

student_verified_through.meaning: Last day of the student verification (student plan only); empty otherwise.

pending_variant_name.meaning: Plan scheduled for the next renewal after a downgrade; none when no change is pending.

closed_date.meaning: Date the membership expired; empty while not expired.

pass_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the membership ledger row.

pass_id.meaning: Membership the row belongs to (foreign key -> pass_memberships).

charge_type.meaning: Kind of fee charge; not_applicable on other rows.

period_start.meaning: First day of the period a charge, refund, decline or notice concerns; empty on benefit rows.

period_end.meaning: Last day of the period a charge pays for; empty on other rows.

amount_usd.meaning: Signed fee delta: positive for charges, negative for refunds; the upcoming fee on notice rows; 0.00 on other rows.

refund_reason.meaning: Why a fee was refunded; not_applicable on other rows.

order_id.meaning: Order (or return's original order) that received a benefit (foreign key -> orders); empty on other rows.

benefit_type.meaning: Kind of benefit used; not_applicable on other rows.

value_usd.meaning: List fee waived by a benefit use; 0.00 on other rows.

attempt_number.meaning: 0 for the scheduled charge, 1-3 for retries, on decline rows; 0 on other rows.

pass_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the membership request.

pass_id.meaning: Membership the request concerns (foreign key -> pass_memberships).

request_status.meaning: Whether the member has personally confirmed the request.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
